court_name: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
petitioner: The Principal, Modern College of Arts, Science and Commerce, Shivaji Nagar, Pune- 5

directives.text: The judgment and order dated 19 November 2014 passed by the learned Member, Industrial Court, Pune in Complaint (ULP) No. 202 of 2009 is quashed and set aside;
Complaint (ULP) No. 202 of 2009 filed by the respondent stands dismissed;
Rule is made absolute in the aforesaid terms;
In the facts and circumstances of the case, there shall be no order as to costs;
Pending interim applications, if any, do not survive and stand disposed of accordingly.

raw_summary: The High Court allowed the writ petition filed by The Principal, thereby quashing and setting aside an Industrial Court's order that found The Principal guilty of unfair labour practices and directed payment of salary to the respondent. The High Court concluded that the respondent failed to establish a legal right to the claimed pay scale, citing insufficient pleadings and lack of proof for appointment on a permanent or sanctioned post. Consequently, the original complaint filed by the respondent was dismissed.
